snippet.title: Tied to the Beat: Song Survivors - 2.0 Trailer
snippet.description:
Tied to the Beat 2.0 is here. Pick a song and its lyrics become the fight: every word you hear lands on the horde.

Ten-minute runs with a boss waiting at the end, five worlds, a portal between songs, enemies that shoot back and elites with tricks of their own.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4316340/
